[attribute-award-type]
=== `@award-type` Type of Award

Type or kind of award (for example, “`grant`” or “`contract`”).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Names the type of award, such as “`contract`” or “`grant`”.
| Restriction| `@award-type` is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
